summary_en: This video demonstrates the preparation and cooking process of stir-fried snails with star fruit. It begins with ingredient introductions and food preparation, followed by slicing star fruit, marinating, and cooking everything together in a pan with seasonings. The final dish is beautifully plated, concluding with program wrap-up discussions and social media information.
